title: Favorite trombone and trumpet players growing up
summary: Sal names Santo Pecora as his favorite trombone player, plus Tommy Dorsey, Miff Mole and Jack Teagarden.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: He's making a living. Oh. Yeah, sure. But who was your favorite, say, trombone player back then when you were coming out? All over the country, just here. Just here, when you were growing up, when you were a kid. In New Orleans? Mm-hmm. That you used to listen to. All strong. All strong.

Oh man. He said trombone player. Oh. Santa Pecola. Without a doubt. Santa. When you're playing at the palace man. I was going to stay in bed. Good night, he got so many now, the A-blankin, you know. Mm-hmm. But I mean, back in those days, I liked Mithmo and T. Gordon. What about… Go ahead. Trumpet.
